arguments.summary: Credential compromise on WS-FIN-AP01 initiated via phishing email with malicious PowerShell payload. Attack originated from external IP 185.220.101.42, which previously conducted reconnaissance against internal IT asset WS-IT-101. The payload established C2 beaconing via rundll32.exe loading an unsigned DLL from the Temp directory. UEBA did not flag the activity due to low anomaly score, but EDR telemetry confirmed malicious process chain. No lateral movement or data exfiltration observed during monitoring window.

timeline.description: External IP 185.220.101.42 conducts Nmap SYN scan against WS-IT-101 (10.0.2.15). Logged as low-severity event.
User CORP\jsmith launches Outlook.exe on WS-FIN-AP01.
Outlook spawns encoded PowerShell process (T1566.001).
PowerShell executes rundll32.exe to load unsigned beacon.dll from Temp directory (T1218.011).
Beacon establishes outbound C2 communication over port 443 (T1071.001). Host file modification detected (T1565.001).
Incident detected and escalated for analysis.

title: Suspicious PowerShell Launched from Office Application
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    ParentImage|endswith: '\\outlook.exe'
    Image|endswith: '\\powershell.exe'
    CommandLine|contains: '-nop'
    CommandLine|contains: '-w hidden'
    CommandLine|contains: '-encodedcommand'
  condition: selection
level: high
references:
  - https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1566/001/
description: Detects encoded PowerShell execution from Outlook, commonly seen in phishing payloads.

rule Suspicious_Rundll32_Temp_Load {
    meta:
        description = "Detects rundll32 loading DLL from user Temp directory"
        author = "SOC Team"
        reference = "MITRE T1218.011"
        category = "malware"
    strings:
        $s1 = "rundll32.exe" nocase
        $s2 = "\\AppData\\Local\\Temp\\" nocase
        $s3 = ".dll" nocase
    condition:
        $s1 and $s2 and $s3
}
